provenance: DERIVED FROM THE DOCUMENTED EXAMPLE, not observed on a live socket. Every example below is the official page's direct-RTDS update frame with the symbol, the observation timestamp and the E18 value changed; no field was added, removed or renamed. The values are internally consistent under the documented scale (full_accuracy_value / 10^18), which is the only relation this suite asserts about them. Cadence is NOT implied: the instants are chosen to exercise adjacency, a long unobserved interval, and out-of-order arrival, and the page states the windows are lookback windows, not publication cadences.
notes: Base instant 1785178800000 = 2026-07-27T19:00:00.000Z, the same instant the frozen WP-000 fixture uses.

examples.name: thirty-btc-t0
examples.purpose: The documented 30-second example, unchanged; the anchor observation of the btc/usd 30s series.

examples.name: thirty-btc-t1
examples.purpose: A later observation of the same series, 30 seconds after t0.

examples.name: thirty-btc-t2-after-outage
examples.purpose: An observation five minutes after t1, used as the first update following a reconnect.

examples.name: thirty-btc-t1-redelivered
examples.purpose: A byte-identical redelivery of t1, for duplicate handling.

examples.name: thirty-btc-t1-contradicted
examples.purpose: t1's instant restated with a different exact value, for the contradiction path.

examples.name: thirty-btc-sub-wei-precision
examples.purpose: An E18 value whose last digits no IEEE-754 double can hold, proving the exact path never reads the floating `value`.
